wizard.welcomeLead: A Loupist is a research companion for one topic. It watches what you follow, remembers what you read together, and explains what changed, with the sources attached.
wizard.connectBody: Loupist runs on your own AI account. Your sign-in stays on this Mac, and requests go straight to your provider.
wizard.planNote: Uses the plan you already pay for. Loupist doesn't charge you.
wizard.skipConnectNote: Without an account you can set up what you follow and look around. Answers need an AI account.
wizard.loupistDefinition: A Loupist is a research companion for one topic. It remembers what you read together and learns how you like to research.
wizard.newLoupistBody: Choose a focus for your research companion.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.changeLater: You can change its avatar, focus and tone later in Loupist settings.
wizard.backgroundReading: After it saves a source, your Loupist reads it in the background to build its Map and learn methods. That uses your AI account. Turn it off any time in Loupist settings.

notice.title: Before you start
notice.body: Loupist is an AI research tool. When you ask, your Loupist can share its own view on an investment, but it can be wrong, it isn't a licensed financial adviser, and it never places trades. Your decisions and their results are yours.
notice.saveError: Your acknowledgment couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
notice.loadError: The notice status couldn’t be loaded. Please try again.
notice.settingsDescription: AI can be wrong. Not a licensed financial adviser.

tone.title: How should {{name}} talk?
tone.note: Tone changes how your Loupist talks, not the evidence it needs.

careful.label: Careful
careful.description: States uncertainty first, adds caveats and explains terms.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Research language; explains a term the first time it appears.

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Leads with its view, with fewer caveats and expert vocabulary.
